milestones.description: Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The green banner is at spawn-relative (4, 2, 7) mounted on the oak plank pillar. The player must navigate near it and face toward it to demonstrate they have found it. max_distance=16 allows detection from across the room since the banner is clearly visible.

Uses position_near_with_facing because this is a find/locate task. The birch trapdoor is at spawn-relative (7, 1, 8) at the entrance to the oak plank room. Using max_distance=5 because the player must actually approach the small room entrance to see the trapdoor (it's partially hidden within the structure). facing_tolerance=60 ensures the player is looking at it.

Uses inventory_has because mining a dark_oak_wall_sign drops the sign item ('dark_oak_sign') into the player's inventory. The player does not start with any dark_oak_sign, so having at least 1 confirms they mined it. Signs can be mined by hand (no tool required).

Uses count_in_box_at_least (kind=block) because 'build a ladder' means placing a ladder block in the world. The player must craft a ladder using sticks (from inventory + converting oak_planks to sticks at the crafting table) and then place it on a wall. Using a generous box covering the entire room (±10 XZ, -1 to 5 Y) to detect any placed ladder block anywhere in the scene.
